title: 22時の、おかえり
theme: 待たされた時間を責めず、帰ってきたことだけを全身で喜ぶ

slides.text:
22時の玄関で、
この子が待っていたもの
slides.scene: At night, the dog sits upright on the indoor entrance mat facing the closed front door, ears perked, waiting. A single warm lamp is on.
slides.shot: centered view from inside the dim hallway, the dog seen from the side

slides.text:
今日も残業で、
帰りは22時を過ぎた
slides.scene: A quiet late-night street with streetlights; the owner walks home from behind in a charcoal coat carrying a work bag.
slides.shot: wide view from behind the owner

slides.text:
電車の窓に映る自分は、
ひどく疲れた顔をしていた
slides.scene: Inside a nearly empty late-night train, the owner stands holding a strap, seen only from behind, shoulders slumped; dark window with city lights passing. The window glass shows only blurred city lights.
slides.shot: from behind the owner, no face visible anywhere

slides.text:
鍵を回す音が、
やけに大きく響いた
slides.scene: Close-up of the owner's hand turning a key in the front door lock from outside, in dim light.
slides.shot: close-up of hand and keyhole

slides.text:
ドアを開けた瞬間、
小さな足音が飛んできた
slides.scene: The front door opens and the owner steps in from the night, seen only as legs in a charcoal coat hem and black outdoor shoes; the dog leaps toward them from the hallway, ears flying.
slides.shot: low angle from the entrance floor, the owner's shoes at the edge of the frame

slides.text:
しっぽだけじゃない。
体ぜんぶで揺れている
slides.scene: The dog wiggles its whole body with joy at the owner's feet in the entrance; the owner wears black outdoor shoes and the hem of a charcoal coat is visible; tail a blur.
slides.shot: low angle close to the floor, owner's legs only

slides.text:
何時間も、ひとりで
待っていたはずなのに
slides.scene: Earlier in the day: the empty quiet apartment in afternoon light, the dog lying alone on a cushion facing the door.
slides.shot: wide quiet view of the living room

slides.text:
この子の顔には、
文句ひとつ書いていない
slides.scene: Close-up of the dog looking up with bright, completely happy eyes.
slides.shot: close-up portrait of the dog looking up

slides.text:
「遅くなってごめんね」
しゃがんで抱きしめた
slides.scene: The owner, still in the coat, crouches in the entrance and hugs the dog; only the owner's back, arms and coat are visible.
slides.shot: from behind the owner's shoulder, the dog's face over the shoulder

slides.text:
この子にとって、
私の帰りは一日のニュースだ
slides.scene: The dog prances in a circle around the owner's feet in the hallway, bag dropped on the floor.
slides.shot: medium shot at floor level

slides.text:
帰りが何時になっても、
この子の答えは同じだった
slides.scene: A small collage-like row of three moments drawn on the same page: the dog greeting at the door in morning light, in evening light, and at night, always the same happy face.
slides.shot: three small vignettes side by side

slides.text:
それはいつも、
最高の「おかえり」の顔
slides.scene: Close-up of the dog's beaming face, mouth open, eyes sparkling, ears back with joy.
slides.shot: close-up portrait, warm light

slides.text:
コートも脱がずに、
床に座りこんだ
slides.scene: The owner sits on the hallway floor still in the charcoal coat, legs stretched out, seen from behind; the dog climbs onto the legs.
slides.shot: from behind the owner, low angle

slides.text:
膝にのったこの子の
温かさが、じんわり伝わる
slides.scene: The dog curled on the owner's lap, the owner's hands resting on its back; knit sleeves visible under the coat.
slides.shot: close-up of lap, hands and dog

slides.text:
疲れていたのは、
さっきまでの話だった
slides.scene: The owner and the dog on the floor together, the owner's hand scratching behind the dog's ear, the dog's eyes half-closed with pleasure.
slides.shot: close-up of hand and the dog's head

slides.text:
この顔に迎えてもらえる日は、
あと何回あるんだろう
slides.scene: The dog sits by the front door in soft evening light, looking at the door, calm and content.
slides.shot: medium shot from the hallway, peaceful

slides.text:
数えるより、
一回ずつ大事にしたい
slides.scene: The owner's hand and the dog's paw touching on the wooden floor of the hallway.
slides.shot: close-up of hand and paw

slides.text:
だから明日は、
少しでも早く帰ろう
slides.scene: Morning: the owner at the door putting on shoes, the dog watching; the owner's hand gives a gentle pat. Only hands and legs visible.
slides.shot: from the floor, the owner's shoes and hand, the dog in focus

slides.text:
この子がくれる一生分の
「おかえり」に応えるために
slides.scene: The dog sleeping peacefully on the entrance mat with the owner's charcoal coat hanging on the hook above.
slides.shot: quiet wide view of the entrance at night

slides.text:
今日のあなたの「おかえり」は、
誰がくれましたか？
slides.scene: The owner sits on the sofa at night seen from behind, the dog curled against their side, a warm lamp glowing.
slides.shot: from behind the sofa

caption:
何時に帰っても、この子の答えは同じだった。
今日のあなたの「おかえり」は、誰がくれましたか？
youtube_title: 22時の玄関で、この子が待っていたもの
self_review: 留守番を責める表現はない（「待っていたはずなのに」は事実の描写のみ）。別れの語は使わず、16枚目で回数に触れるだけ。決意は『少しでも早く帰ろう』という本人の小さな行動で、説教にしていない。
